name: Orbit Scheduler
observations: Small library that plans recurring jobs with jitter and back-off.
v2.4.0: Added calendar-aware scheduling (business days, holidays).
v2.4.0: Exponential back-off now capped at 30 seconds.
v2.4.0: Fixed a jitter bug that could schedule a job in the past.
v2.3.1: Fixed a memory leak in the job registry.
